speaker: Vera
text: Twelve minutes of darkness. Someone wanted the harbour blind.

speaker: Nanami
text: It just started! Come up to the roof, quick!

speaker: Lyra
text: 私はライラ。あなたを守るために、ここへ来ました。
subtitle: I am Lyra. I have come to protect you.

speaker: Lyra
text: 私と契約を結び、この夜を共に歩んでくれますか。
subtitle: Will you bind a contract with me, and walk this night together?

speaker: Vera
text: ここはね、直せなかったものを置いておく場所なの。
subtitle: This is where I keep the things I couldn't fix.

speaker: Player
text: Vera, what did you find at the lighthouse?

speaker: Player
text: Wataru, did you wait for me?

speaker: Wataru
text: Of course I did. I saved you the seat by the window.
